raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  uhd_lib: uhd
  version: "4.11.0.0"
  nib310rio_version: "1.0.0"

package:
  name: uhd
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/EttusResearch/uhd/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 1e53faec13ea2be9dd8f765956157d1434f41fa0a124fac8f7b2340f8445b026
    patches:
      - 0001-usrp2-Include-DSP-bit-gain-derived-from-peak-stream-.patch
      - 0002-python-Fix-libpyuhd-install_name-on-macOS.patch
      - 0003-cmake-Make-libuhd-linking-to-Python-library-PRIVATE.patch
      - 0004-cmake-Don-t-set-package_dir-in-setup.py.in.patch
      - 0005-cmake-Prefer-python-config-extension-suffix-to-hard-.patch
      - 0006-lib-types-Declare-types-used-with-digital_filter_-ba.patch
      - 0007-cmake-Remove-dynamic_lookup-flat_namespace-linker-fl.patch
      - 0008-utils-rfnoc_modtool-Add-main-function-so-it-can-be-a.patch
      - 0009-Add-option-to-control-building-a-Python-wheel.patch
      - 0010-Adjust-pyproject.toml-to-be-looser-on-Python-version.patch
      - 0011-cmake-Use-CONFIG-mode-to-find-protobuf.patch
      - 0012-cmake-Add-missing-log_add_impl.hpp-to-distributed-he.patch
  - url: https://launchpad.net/~ettusresearch/+archive/ubuntu/uhd/+sourcefiles/nib310rio/${{ nib310rio_version }}-0ubuntu1~resolute1/nib310rio_${{ nib310rio_version }}.orig.tar.xz
    sha256: afbbdb12f9565a0ac20542c44c5f37e76ad549afc5ee333958a7e12bd846d347
    target_directory: nib310rio

build:
  number: 3
  python:
    entry_points:
      - if: win
        then:
          - rfnoc_image_builder = uhd.rfnoc_image_builder_cmd:main
          - rfnoc_modtool = uhd.rfnoc_modtool_cmd:main
          - usrpctl = uhd.usrpctl_script_cmd:main
      - if: not linux
        then: uhd_images_downloader = uhd.uhd_images_downloader_cmd:main
      - uhd_convert_cal_data = uhd.utils.convert_cal_data:main
      - uhd_power_cal = uhd.utils.uhd_power_cal:main

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        # needs to run protoc & grpc_cpp_plugin
        - libgrpc
        - libprotobuf
        - pybind11
        - numpy
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - cmake >=3.5.1
    - ninja
    - pkg-config
  host:
    # B300 code requires <linux/dma-buf.h>, which is not included in Linux
    # kernel 3.10.0 used by the default sysroot of 2.17 (as of writing).
    # We could require c_stdlib_version of 2.28 to get a new enough kernel
    # version, but instead we depend on the newer kernel-headers package
    # directly in host (so it doesn't conflict with the default sysroot)
    # and rely on the fact that only the B300 code really uses the kernel
    # headers and so we don't break default sysroot compatibility except
    # for B300 which requires an external kernel module anyway.
    - if: linux
      then: kernel-headers_${{ target_platform }} ==4.18.0
    - libabseil
    - libboost-devel
    - libgrpc
    - libprotobuf
    - libusb
    - mako >=0.5.0
    - if: not win
      then: ncurses
    - numpy
    - if: win
      then: pip
    - if: win
      then: poetry
    - pybind11
    - python
    - requests
    - ruamel.yaml
    - setuptools
  run:
    - mako >=0.5.0
    - if: not win
      then: ncurses
    - python
    - pyyaml
    - requests
    - ruamel.yaml
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("uhd", lower_bound="x.x.x", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - rfnoc_image_builder
        - rfnoc_modtool
        - uhd_adc_self_cal
        - uhd_cal_rx_iq_balance
        - uhd_cal_tx_dc_offset
        - uhd_cal_tx_iq_balance
        - uhd_config_info
        - uhd_convert_cal_data
        - uhd_find_devices
        - uhd_image_loader
        - uhd_images_downloader
        - uhd_power_cal
        - uhd_usrp_probe
        - usrpctl
        - if: linux
          then: usrp2_card_burner
      include:
        - if: linux
          then: nib310rio/nib310rio.h
        - uhd.h
        - uhd/**
      lib:
        - uhd
      files:
        - ${{ "Lib/" if win else "lib/python*" }}site-packages/uhd/**
        - if: win
          then: Lib/site-packages/uhd-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/cmake/uhd/*.cmake
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/uhd/**
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/pkgconfig/uhd.pc
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/doc/uhd/**
        - if: unix
          then:
            - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/man/man1/rfnoc*
            - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/man/man1/uhd*
            - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/man/man1/usrp*
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/uhd/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Scripts/rfnoc*-script.py
            - Scripts/uhd*-script.py
            - Scripts/usrp*-script.py
  - python:
      imports:
        - uhd
      pip_check: false
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then:
          # expect exit code of 1 for --help
          - uhd_images_downloader --help || (($? == 1))
          - usrpctl --help || (($? == 1))
          - rfnoc_image_builder --help || (($? == 1))
        else:
          - uhd_images_downloader --help || if !ERRORLEVEL! LEQ 1 cmd /c "exit /b 0"
          - usrpctl --help || if !ERRORLEVEL! LEQ 1 cmd /c "exit /b 0"
          - rfnoc_image_builder --help || if !ERRORLEVEL! LEQ 1 cmd /c "exit /b 0"
      - uhd_config_info --print-all
      - if: unix
        then: uhd_find_devices || (($? < 128))

about:

  license_file: host/LICENSE
  summary: Software driver and API for the Ettus Research USRP SDR platform
  description: |

  homepage: httsp://github.com/EttusResearch/uhd
